newsitem.title: USA: Florida Power & Light to prepay Miami.
newsitem.headline: Florida Power & Light to prepay Miami.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co said Wednesday it will advance the City of Miami $3 million in franchise fee payments to help the city manage a $68 million budget shortfall.
The electric utility, a unit of FPL Group Inc, said it was responding to an appeal from Mayor Joe Carollo and Acting City Manager Merrett Stierheim.
The $3 million is the amount FPL estimated it would have paid to the city for the first three months of 1997. FPL said it expects to make the prepayment this week.

The utility is one of more than a dozen companies that have temporarily loaned auditors and finance experts to Miami to help it draft a plan to close the $68 million shortfall in the $275 million budget for the year that began Oct 1.
Earlier this month, the State of Florida prepaid the city $22 million in shared tax revenues that the city would otherwise have received in monthly installments, to help Miami through its crisis.
